levels.name: OceanLab
levels.blocker: The FilterWorldThroughBrush-classify hypothesis is REFUTED (2026-09-15) -- UED22's own GDiscarded is CONSUME too, same as native. THE REAL BUG IS FOUND AND FIXED (2026-09-15/16): UED22's bspRepartition calls bspRefresh(Model, NoRemapSurfs=1), suppressing surf compaction -- a dead node's surf/point survives untouched until bspOptGeom's own bspRefresh(Model, 0), which runs AFTER its point-merge. Native compacted eagerly right after repartition, before the merge could weld a later brush's near-coincident point onto the dead surf's older point. Fixed: carry a dead node's surf forward across repartition, port the previously-unwired compaction inside bsp_opt_geom. Model2.points is now byte-identical at N=203; all 2640 live BSP node rings match. parity_gate.py STILL FAILS -- one extra orphan (unreferenced) Verts entry on the UED22 side desyncs the gate's positional walk, a gate-mechanism gap the existing orphan-vert exclusion was never built to tolerate (count mismatch, not just content). Owner asked to confirm the mechanism before deciding whether to widen the exclusion or chase a byte-exact count -- not yet done.
